title: Financial Twin
disclosure: Financial Twin is an educational simulation. Its outcomes are illustrative and do not represent actual product terms, rewards, savings, eligibility, or account activity.

pathways.name: Horizon Active Cash
pathways.description: A simulation lens for everyday purchase decisions and simple rewards tradeoffs.

pathways.name: Horizon Travel Rewards
pathways.description: A simulation lens for trip timing, experiences, and travel-reward tradeoffs.

pathways.name: Horizon Everyday + Way2Save
pathways.description: A simulation lens for maintaining a cushion and keeping a savings goal in view.

chapters.title: Starting point
chapters.description: Set your rhythm before the year gets busy.

events.title: A repair you did not plan for
events.body: Your car needs a repair before a week of commitments. You want to keep moving without losing sight of your reserve.

choices.label: Use part of my cash cushion
choices.body: Pay the repair now and pause a planned goal contribution.

choices.label: Split the expense across two paychecks
choices.body: Keep more cash available now and make a smaller goal adjustment.

choices.label: Delay the repair and reprioritize
choices.body: Hold cash today, with a tradeoff to routine and future flexibility.

events.title: A little room after payday
events.body: A regular deposit clears. You have a small amount to direct before the next month begins.

choices.label: Put most of it toward my reserve
choices.body: Build the cushion before adding anything new.

choices.label: Split it between spending and saving
choices.body: Make visible progress while leaving room for everyday plans.

choices.label: Use it for a long-awaited purchase
choices.body: Choose a near-term priority and keep the goal steady for now.

chapters.title: Everyday pressure
chapters.description: A few ordinary decisions start to stack up.

events.title: Small subscriptions, bigger total
events.body: You notice a few recurring charges have grown into a meaningful monthly amount.

choices.label: Trim and move the difference to my goal
choices.body: Reduce recurring spend and turn it into a monthly habit.

choices.label: Keep the services I use most
choices.body: Keep the routines that matter and make a smaller change elsewhere.

choices.label: Leave it for later
choices.body: Keep the month simple and revisit it when time allows.

events.title: A trip invite arrives
events.body: Friends are planning a long weekend. The timing is good, but the budget is not automatic.

choices.label: Go, with a clear trip budget
choices.body: Join the trip while choosing a capped total and a lighter goal contribution.

choices.label: Join for a shorter version
choices.body: Keep the experience while reducing travel and lodging costs.

choices.label: Pass and strengthen my goal
choices.body: Use the planned spend to make noticeable reserve progress.

chapters.title: Opportunity moment
chapters.description: A new possibility changes the shape of the year.

events.title: A home project becomes urgent
events.body: A small repair could become a bigger issue if you wait through another season.

choices.label: Complete the repair now
choices.body: Address it early and keep future disruption lower in the simulation.

choices.label: Choose a temporary fix
choices.body: Reduce the near-term hit while setting a later repair plan.

choices.label: Wait and protect cash
choices.body: Keep the cushion today, accepting more uncertainty later.

events.title: An unexpected bonus
events.body: A small one-time bonus shows up. It can support any priority you choose.

choices.label: Put it all toward my reserve
choices.body: Convert a one-time lift into a stronger base.

choices.label: Share it between goals and fun
choices.body: Give the future and the present a visible share.

choices.label: Fund a meaningful experience
choices.body: Make room for a planned memory and leave the goal unchanged.

chapters.title: Year-end reflection
chapters.description: Finish the season with a clearer picture of your tradeoffs.

events.title: A health expense arrives
events.body: A routine visit turns into an unexpected bill just before the holidays.

choices.label: Pay from my cushion
choices.body: Use available cash and keep other commitments unchanged.

choices.label: Set a payment plan
choices.body: Preserve more immediate cash while committing to a future monthly amount.

choices.label: Adjust my holiday plan now
choices.body: Create room early and keep the bill from crowding the next month.

events.title: Close out the season
events.body: You can choose the final emphasis before your Financial Twin recap.

choices.label: Make one final goal contribution
choices.body: Carry forward a stronger reserve and a clear next milestone.

choices.label: Keep a balanced finish
choices.body: Leave room in cash while making steady progress.

choices.label: Keep cash flexible
choices.body: Hold more cash for a fresh start and reset the goal next month.
